title: Here’s How to Watch UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling Live Online for Free
summary: Live from Qatar on Nov. 21, you can watch the entire MMA event online for free.
contentText:

Ahead of UFC 335 in Las Vegas, the UFC heads to Qatar for UFC Fight Night. Two elite fighters face off in the epic light heavyweight main event, as Czech fighter Jiří Procházka (32-6-1) takes on New Zealander Navajo Stirling (11-0-0).

Watch UFC Fight Night with DirectV free trial

On Saturday (Nov. 21), UFC Fight Night takes place at ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar, with a start time of 10 a.m. ET/7 a.m. PT.

How to Watch UFC Fight Night Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Saturday, Nov. 21

- Main Event Matchups: Jiří Procházka vs. Navajo Stirling

- Online Streaming: Paramount+ , DirecTV

What Is the Main Event’s Walkout Music for UFC Fight Night?

Although the UFC has yet to announce each fighter’s walkout songs for UFC Fight Night, they usually go out to the octagon to the same songs during their matches. Procházka has walked out to “In the City” by Kevin Rudolf, while Navajo Stirling prefers to walk out to music from Wardruna.

After the free trial ends, your plan will automatically renew at the regular rate, but you can cancel any time.

Get 5-Day Free Trial

With a five-day free trial, the streaming service DirecTV comes with free access to Paramount+ with its “Premier” package , which goes for $129.99 per month for the first two months of service ($174.99 per month afterward). It features more than 185 channels, as well as access to ESPN Unlimited, HBO Max, Disney+, Hulu and other streaming services, unlimited DVR storage and the ability to stream on three devices simultaneously. Once the five days are up you’ll be charged the subscription price based on what package you choose at checkout.

NEW STREAMING DEAL

Paramount+ on Walmart+

Shoppers can receive access to Paramount+ included with any Walmart+ subscription , the retail giant announced last September. A Walmart+ subscription is $98 for the annual plan (about $8.17 per month) after the 30-day trial.
